repo.description: A small self-hosted F-Droid repository. Currently carries Pomodoro Timer, a fully offline focus timer with no network permission, no ads and no tracking.

apps.description:
A Pomodoro focus timer: choose how long to work, start it, and take a break
when it ends.

The countdown is driven by a deadline rather than by counting ticks, so it does
not drift, and an exact alarm means a finished session announces itself even if
Android has shut the app down in the meantime.

Features:

* Work presets of 15, 30 and 45 minutes; break presets of 5, 10 and 15
* Any custom length from 1 to 180 minutes
* A depleting ring showing the time remaining, sized to your screen
* A completed-session count that survives the app being closed
* Three themes: Black, Paper and Mist
* A live countdown in the notification shade
* An optional "keep screen on" switch

Privacy: this app has no internet permission at all, so it cannot send anything
anywhere. There are no adverts, no analytics, no accounts and no tracking. The
only things it remembers, your chosen theme and your session count, stay on your
device, and Android backup is disabled so they are not copied off it either.

Requires Android 8.0 or newer.
